dataList.content:
The Night Drifter stumbled. He smelled of pungent, bitter wine.
……从他摇摇晃晃的身上飘散出的，是股醇厚刺鼻的酒气。

When the unsieved dregs of old, cloudy wine settle and the bitter life is left behind...
陈年的浓烈浊酒。未滤尽的酒渣沉淀后。

... the clear, crisp waters shall spring forth, twinkling under the sun's apricity.
那跨越苦涩的人生而最终凝结出的，澄澈的精髓……终会在阳光下浮现吧。
